realizes.rationale: Declares the schema-validated global hash-pinned catalog lock with exact PyPI wheel SHA-256 hashes, query SHA-256 digests, wrappers, destructuring specs, reserved suffixes, ambiguous suffixes, and languagePack pin.

1.note: The lockfile pins `schema` (`ar-language-catalog/v1`), `treeSitter` version `0.26.1` (`abiMin: 13`, `abiMax: 15`), reserved `.lean`, ambiguous `.h`/`.m`/`.v`, and `languagePack` wheels alongside uniform `languages` entries (`python`, `typescript`, `tsx`, `javascript`, `lean`).
